name: @returnpath/cli
description: Offline return-path analysis of EasyEDA Pro files: file parser, SVG/PNG overlay and JSON report

scripts.synth: tsx src/synth/make-board.ts examples && tsx src/synth/make-dc-board.ts examples && tsx src/synth/make-2layer-board.ts examples
scripts.demo: npm run synth && tsx src/cli.ts examples/demo-4layer.epro --net CLK --name demo-clk --png && tsx src/cli.ts examples/fixed-4layer.epro --net CLK --name fixed-clk --png
scripts.demo:2layer: tsx src/synth/make-2layer-board.ts examples && tsx src/cli.ts examples/2layer-coplanar.epro --net CLK --png && tsx src/cli.ts examples/2layer-coplanar.epro --net DATA --png && tsx src/cli.ts examples/2layer-bottom-only.epro --net CLK --png && tsx src/cli.ts examples/2layer-coplanar.epro --dc 3V3 --png && tsx src/cli.ts examples/2layer-bottom-only.epro --dc 3V3 --png
scripts.demo:dc: tsx src/synth/make-dc-board.ts examples && tsx src/cli.ts examples/dc-4layer.epro --dc 3V3 --name dc-3v3 --png && tsx src/cli.ts examples/dc-4layer.epro --dc VBUS --name dc-vbus --png
